verdict.rationale: Productboard documents a comprehensive public REST API (feedback, features, customers, teams, webhooks, analytics, dynamic field discovery, pagination) at developer.productboard.com, with an llms.txt confirming a documented, crawlable API surface, plus an official MCP server enabling AI agents to drive feature/initiative workflows. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s on standard paths) and independent third-party corroboration of API robustness.
